scope: Actual UI/client source mounted in jsdom against real in-memory HTTP/WebSocket server; Profiler commit counts, not browser layout/latency.

observations.name: link_provider_unrelated_connected_count
observations.transport: Real HTTP/socket client; simulated desktop HostingStatus bridge subscription
observations.limitation: Profiler observes React commits in jsdom; no packaged Electron IPC, production React timing, browser layout or paint measurement.

observations.name: activity_equal_count_invalidation_burst
observations.transport: Real gateway frames and HTTP responses; response delivery held after real fetch
observations.limitation: Invalidations deliberately spaced across React effect turns; same-turn updates can batch. Network/server work occurs before the delivery gate; no latency or body-waste measurement.

observations.name: visible_thread_unrelated_live_message
observations.transport: Real HTTP send and reader WebSocket into actual ThreadPanel
observations.limitation: Read marking disabled to isolate render churn; jsdom does no real scroll geometry or layout.
